top_categories.workout_context: 71 miles on fast coastal roads with one gradual inland climb burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Puerto Rico's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before March.
GFNY Puerto Rico's fast coastal roads with one gradual inland climb forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 71 miles.
When someone attacks on fast coastal roads with one gradual inland climb, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
GFNY Puerto Rico's fast coastal roads with one gradual inland climb rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Base fitness for GFNY Puerto Rico. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At GFNY Puerto Rico, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
2-minute all-out efforts on fast coastal roads with one gradual inland climb. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Puerto Rico. Train it until it feels boring.
At GFNY Puerto Rico, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
The aerobic base that lets you ride fast coastal roads with one gradual inland climb at tempo for 71 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what GFNY Puerto Rico's fast coastal roads with one gradual inland climb actually does to you.

race_overlay.heat: March in Ponce, Puerto Rico, USA can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before GFNY Puerto Rico. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for GFNY Puerto Rico’s 71 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at GFNY Puerto Rico requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on fast coastal roads with one gradual inland climb to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Race Simulation, and Road Specific to prepare you for 71 miles of fast coastal roads with one gradual inland climb in Ponce, Puerto Rico, USA.
